verdict: Instagram leads flowing at roughly $23 each — well below legal benchmarks — but reviews and intake need attention.
diagnosis: 495 leads from $11,440 spend this period means about $23 per lead, far under the $72 Meta legal average and $131 search average.

signals.headline: 495 leads at roughly $23 each
signals.detail: Instagram lead campaign is producing strong volume at a cost well below legal industry norms this period.

signals.headline: 7,511 clicks, only 3,635 to site
signals.detail: About half of ad clicks never reach the landing page. Form drop-off or load issues worth investigating.

signals.headline: 203 phone calls from Google profile
signals.detail: Local listing drove meaningful call volume this period. Phone remains a primary intake channel for the firm.

signals.headline: Average review rating slipped to 3.67
signals.detail: Latest period rating dropped from the 4.69 average. Three new reviews pulled the score down noticeably.

signals.headline: Only 38 Instagram followers
signals.detail: Organic social presence is minimal despite heavy paid activity. No audience being built for retargeting or nurture.

recommendations.title: Investigate the click-to-landing-page drop-off
recommendations.detail: Half of ad clicks never register as landing page views this period. Test page load speed, mobile rendering, and tracking pixel setup to recover lost leads.

recommendations.title: Launch a review request push to intake clients
recommendations.detail: Latest rating fell to 3.67 from a 4.69 average. Consider texting recent satisfied clients a direct review link to rebuild the star average.

recommendations.title: Test a second video creative against Ad 04 V4
recommendations.detail: The current video is carrying the campaign. A second variant on the same offer protects against fatigue and gives Meta more learning signal.
